tasks.short: Inspect finished shoes against specifications and record actual results.

steps.what: Inspect actual finished shoes against the applicable completion specifications
inputs: current shoe specifications supplied with the work order

steps.what: Enter actual assigned inspection results and exceptions in the quality record
inputs: actual work-order reference already supplied by production

tasks.design: Use the existing quality-record form's work-order context to avoid repeatedly entering stable shoe and order references. Actual finished-shoe inspection, finding capture, exception description and ordinary save remain with the operator; the form does not inspect shoes or release a shipment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable order references may be retyped when recording actual inspection results.
tasks.enabler_now: Native quality forms can retain the selected work-order context.
tasks.still_hard: Physical finish, fit of parts and specification compliance remain actual inspection work.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a physical defect despite a correct order reference.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated references while preserving actual quality checks.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an order-linked quality form can reuse stable references but does not perform physical shoe inspection.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM means the existing production quality-record module. Shares85/15 are provisional, not measured, and apply only if the operator actually records these results today; otherwise remove s2 and reweight actual inspection without inventing paperwork.

Only1.5 points of stable reference entry disappear. Fresh findings, exception prose, checking and ordinary save remain retained13.5; no self-approval gate or auto-release is added. The textile-machine digest does not establish shoe defect-detection capability.
unknowns: Are inspection records actually assigned and already linked to work orders?
research_questions: Time actual inspection and result entry separately.

incremental.description: Maintain the quality form's actual order-context fields.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes1.5 repeated-reference points less0.3 upkeep. Low: mixed rework orders require manual order reconciliation, leaving only0.4 stable style-reference entry removable, less0.3 upkeep. Actual inspection85 and fresh finding entry remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study actual shoe work orders and part tags for workload, specifications and materials.

steps.what: Locate the current work order and its shoe-part specifications
inputs: current work orders and part references supplied by production planning

steps.what: Study work orders and actual shoe tags for workloads, specifications and required materials
outputs: understood workload, specifications and required materials

tasks.design: Configure a direct native production work-order view with its existing specification links. Reduce repeated navigation only; the operator still studies actual orders and shoe-part tags and resolves the meaning of materials and workload.
tasks.previous_blocker: The correct order and specification may require repeated screen navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing work-order links can expose the current source directly.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding actual specifications and reconciling physical tags remain human.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when a physical tag does not match the displayed order.
tasks.altitude: Start from the correct source without replacing order understanding.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a native work-order view can reduce navigation but cannot remove studying actual shoe-part requirements.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM means the production work-order module. Shares10/90 are provisional, not measured. Only2 points of s1 navigation disappear; reading and source checking remain8.

The actual task here is studying sources. Record/report/send boundaries inspected: no separate acknowledgement, settings commit or report is assigned in this scenario. Any actual owned write must be mapped separately. Paper-only tags receive no digital navigation credit.
unknowns: Are current specifications linked to the native order?
research_questions: Observe screen navigation separately from studying order content.

incremental.description: Maintain the actual specification links in the work-order view.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes2 repeated-navigation points less0.3 upkeep. Low: paper-only part tags and unlinked legacy specifications provide no reusable digital route, so all source finding and studying remain and net benefit floors at0.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and physically place thread spools or bobbins on stitching machines.

steps.what: Select actual thread spools or pre-wound bobbins suited to the stitching job
inputs: actual available thread spools and bobbins

steps.what: Place actual spools or bobbins into the stitching machine and verify physical seating
outputs: actual correctly placed spools or bobbins

tasks.design: Keep physical selection and placement with the operator. A native material-reference display or stock form cannot handle these actual spools, bobbins and stitching-machine fittings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual parts require physical suitability checks and handling.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported software change performs these defined physical actions.
tasks.still_hard: Actual thread suitability and correct physical placement remain manual.
tasks.human_edge: Detect an unsuitable spool or poor physical seating despite matching reference numbers.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: stock/reference displays do not physically select and install actual stitching-machine spools or bobbins.

assumptions: Shares40/60 are provisional, not measured. Record/write/report/send boundaries inspected: this scenario assigns physical selection and installation, not a stock issue or settings commit. Any actual owned stock entry or machine commit must be split and assessed before applying this zero; it is not folded into physical placement.
No robot, new machine loader or invented stock-record baseline is proposed. The digest's weaving count capture does not establish a change to these physical shoe-machine actions.
unknowns: Does this operator also own an actual stock issue or machine settings commit?
research_questions: Identify any actual written transaction separately from physical spool placement.

incremental.description: No software change is proposed, so no incremental maintenance is assigned.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both bounds retain selection40 and physical placement60. A native reference or stock form does not perform either action. Any actual assigned stock or settings transaction requires its own separate assessment before applying this zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Preserve physical shoe inspection and setup while reducing actual order-reference repetition.
skills_to_grow: Reconcile physical tags with current orders
